recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a male country artist in a cowboy hat and denim jacket, seated outdoors with an acoustic guitar. The composition features bold, distressed red display typography overlaid across the center, with a secondary serif subtitle below.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed at viewer creates personal connection
Red typography contrasts against blue denim and green/brown background
Distressed textures in text mirror the rugged outdoor setting
Guitar neck provides a strong vertical line framing the left side

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, seated and leaning slightly forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The artist's face and the bright cream cowboy hat serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the face, moves down the guitar neck to the large red text, then to the subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Soft-focus trees and sky in the upper left provide breathing room for the guitar headstock.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blues and greens from denim and nature provide the base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red in the primary typography provides high-impact contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cream/off-white from the hat and subtitle text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Desaturated, earthy background tones allow the saturated red text to pop.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy vertical strokes with thin horizontal slabs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a weathered, condensed display face with a clean, widely-spaced classical serif.
graphicDevices: Subtle horizontal lines behind the main text suggesting musical staff or speed

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man in his 50s with dark hair, wearing a cream cowboy hat and a denim jacket, sitting outdoors in a rural field with an acoustic guitar. Soft natural lighting, shallow depth of field with blurred trees in the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, ultra-condensed red slab-serif text across the center with a weathered texture and black drop shadow. Below it, add a secondary line of text in a cream-colored, widely-spaced serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the red text distressed and weathered?
Is the subject wearing a denim jacket?
Is the subtitle text widely tracked?

adjustableVariables: Depth of field in the background
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Any specific brand logos on the guitar or clothing
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the guitar neck does not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the red text is the most vibrant element in the frame.
Verify the cowboy hat has a distinct western shape.
Confirm the background is sufficiently blurred to create depth.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rugged outdoor portrait in denim with high-impact, condensed, weathered slab-serif typography in a contrasting warm color.
